tool_args.rationale: The pilot has a sink gradient above 2.36 and approaches the documented critical range 2.50–2.68. A high-gradient probe can distinguish an ordinary saturating siphon from a supercritical avalanche before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the ordinary siphon with a square-root branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot ends at s_grad 2.44, close to the archived avalanche threshold; it cannot identify behavior above that threshold.
The immediate ambiguity concerns the high-gradient threshold, not a demonstrated memory trajectory.
It does not discriminate the plausible threshold mechanism.
